creator: Alexander Terp
description: Found by exploration in round 1 (2026-09-24), not investigated further. In session::submit a new tab always comes on screen, so CreateTab.take_focus has no effect. corpus/conformance/cli.json case 56 is named 'making a tab does not move the keyboard' but pins --focus -> take_focus: true. Decide what making a tab should do to the keyboard, then make the field, the case name and the behavior agree.
title: CreateTab.take_focus does nothing, and its corpus case says the opposite of what it pins
